findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene-hook"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Two text blocks overlap and may render unreadable.
findings.fixHint: Give each block its own zone, or put data-layout-allow-overlap on the text or on a container inside the scene. A marker on the scene root does not apply. Decoration nobody needs to read can take data-layout-ignore.

findings.message: Element extends outside a clipping layout container.
findings.fixHint: Resize/reposition the child or container, or mark intentional overflow with data-layout-allow-overflow.
